timing: After initial model tables were produced and inspected; triggered by structural duplicate-key QC, not by effect direction or P value.
issue: The extractor emitted one aggregate row per processing chunk. The primary make_sample routine summed those rows and was algebraically invariant, but the descriptive fixed epithelial-state family paired rows directly and could create Cartesian duplicates.
correction: Before writing, consolidate chunk rows to unique cell_set x sample x released-state keys; sum counts and normalized sums, and recompute cell-weighted QC means. Abort if any key remains duplicated.
expected_impact: The two main patient-level axes and decomposition should be numerically unchanged up to floating-point formatting. The descriptive epithelial-state family must be replaced.
verification_plan: exact comparison of primary and joint model tables before versus after
